about: Sun TV Network Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in producing and broadcasting satellite television and radio software programming in the regional languages. The company's flagship channel is Sun TV. It also operates various other satellite channels, such as Surya TV, Gemini TV, Udaya TV, SUN Bangla, Sun Neo, and Sun Marathi; 24 frequency modulation radio stations; SunRisers Hyderabad, an Indian Premier League franchise; Sun Risers Eastern Cape, a South Africa Premier League franc
